name: Games to Learn English
description_short: 50+ small browser games covering tenses, vocabulary, spelling, and phrasal verbs — click-and-play with no setup, good for a quick warm-up or drill.
teacher_note: Good filler when a lesson finishes early — pick a game that matches whatever grammar point you were just working on.
creator: Owen Dwyer
internal_notes: Verified live: free, no login or payment. cefr_level set specific A1-B1 based on the site's own content range (tenses, basic vocab, spelling) rather than guessed higher. age_group/group_fit left unknown — no stated audience claim, and games are single-player by design so group_fit is genuinely unassessed rather than not_applicable.
